text:
Hannah R.: Hey eng-runtime — we need a compact, publish-ready bench bundle for next week's launch blog + webinar. Short scope: prioritized payloads + CSV of latency/cost numbers + a 2-3 line "methodology" snippet we can drop into the post.
Omar V.: timeline? demo rehearsal Wed. Can marketing get prelims by Tue midday?
Gwen L.: metrics we need: p50/p95/p99 (ms), tokens/s, GPU memory (GB), and an estimated cost_per_1k_tokens. Also mark cache state (cold/warm).
Riley J.: do you want both FP16 and quantized runs? Also confirm sequence lengths and concurrency targets.
Hannah R.: FP16 + int8 where supported. Keep payloads minimal: short chat (<=48t), assistant (256t), long generation (1024t), 200t summarization, embedding (512 dim). Profiles: single-request latency and 75req burst (75 concurrent).
Gwen L.: for quality checks we only need a small delta test: 30-sample eval comparing fp16 vs int8 with simple fluency/exact-match flags. If quantized shows >6% regression, call it out.
runtime-bot: bench template: https://internal.redwood/ops/benchmarks/quick-pack (private)
Riley J.: suggested bench matrix: precisions [fp16,int8], seq_lens [48,256,1024], concurrency [1,75], cache_states [cold,warm], N=3 for prelims. Capture cold as empty KV & new process, warm as one warm pass then measure.
Omar V.: please include a CSV with these columns: payload_id, model, variant, seq_len, concurrency, cache_state, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tps, gpu_mem_gb, cost_per_1k_tokens, notes.
Hannah R.: also need a single reproducibility line we can paste. Example run we can show to users?
Riley J.: yes — we'll publish this example command:
```bash
SEED=7 ./run_bench --model redwood-xlarge-v1 --precision fp16 --seq 1024 --concurrency 75 --cache warm
```
Riley J.: and a minimal quant config snippet for the appendix:
```json
{"quantize": true, "backend": "int8", "calib_samples": 400}
```
Gwen L.: main risk is GPU queue time. If marketing accepts a single-zone (us-central1) preliminary CSV by Tue, we'll follow with full multi-zone sweep after launch. We'll mark outputs with "PRELIM - us-central1".
Omar V.: if queue exceeds 2h please fall back to N=3 medians per config for prelims. That should be acceptable.
runtime-bot: scheduled job bench/launch/1876543210 owner:riley.j eta:2026-01-14T12:00:00-08:00
Riley J.: I'll own the run and upload artifacts: prelim CSV, 3-bullet methodology, raw logs, and 30-sample quality diffs. ETA Tue 12:00 PT.
Hannah R.: perfect — ping this thread when uploads are live. We'll add the CSV to the blog assets and include the methodology blurb in the launch notes. Thanks everyone :tada:
Gwen L.: adding a short note to the post: "Preliminary numbers from a single region; cross-region results to follow."
Omar V.: great — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Riley J.: will update if queue or failures occur. If we hit any quant failures we'll flag in the notes.
Hannah R.: thanks all.
